# Lyra Watch

> Lyra Watch tracks what the media says about politicians, investors, executives and public figures:
> who is named in the news, their job, a 0–100 popularity rating, their documented political
> affiliation, the issues their coverage is about and the companies they are linked to. All data is
> public JSON with stable URLs; link to it freely.

## Data (JSON, no key needed)

- [People index](https://lyraauth.com/api/watch/people): everyone the coverage names who has a Wikipedia article or is on the watchlist. Query parameters: `q` (search name, job or company), `watched=true|false`, `limit` (up to 500).
- [One person](https://lyraauth.com/api/watch/people/keir-starmer): `/api/watch/people/{id}`, where `id` is the lowercase name with hyphens (e.g. `jensen-huang`, `flavio-bolsonaro`). Fields: `job`, `popularity` {score, tier, basis}, `politics` {parties, offices, basis, source, political_coverage}, `interests` [{topic, share}], `companies`, `tone`, `headlines`, `links`.
- [Story feed](https://lyraauth.com/api/watch/feed.json): JSON Feed 1.1 of the latest headlines, one hour behind the live subscriber stream. Each item lists the people named with links to their JSON records.
- [Watchlist](https://lyraauth.com/api/watch/figures): the tracked politicians, investors, executives and public figures, with disclosed trades and power moves at `/api/watch/figures/{slug}`.
- [Health](https://lyraauth.com/api/watch/health): whether the data is up to date.

- Accounts and posts: each person record has `accounts` (official handles from Wikidata, with `read: true` where Lyra reads the free feed: YouTube, Bluesky, Mastodon, official websites) and, for the watchlist, `posts`: their own recent posts plus news stories about posts on X, Truth Social, Instagram, TikTok and others (`reported: true`; the post may be by or about them).

## How to read the fields

- `popularity.score` is 70% Wikipedia page views over the last 30 days (log scale) and 30% headline count. It measures attention now, not lifetime fame.
- `politics` holds only documented facts (party membership and current offices from Wikidata or an official source, linked in `source`). Lyra never infers anyone's political views. `political_coverage` is the share of their headlines about elections, taxes, immigration, trade or policy.
- `interests` are the topics their news coverage is about, as a share of their headlines.
- `tone` is a keyword score of their headlines, not a judgement of the person.

## Pages for people

- [Lyra Watch](https://lyraauth.com/watch/): the directory. A person's page is `https://lyraauth.com/watch/#person/{id}`.
- [Lyra Watch Live](https://lyraauth.com/watch/live/): the real-time stream, for subscribers.
